items.title: 9.3 Digital Collaboration and Equity in Computing (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.3: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 128-129, printed 124-125).

blocks.text: Digital collaboration ka matlab hai technology ke zariye mushtarka (shared) kaamon, projects ya khayalat par mil kar kaam karna. Yeh logon ko internet ke zariye mukhtalif jagahon se jurne aur hissa dalne deta hai. Talaba seekhte hain ke digital mahol mein teamwork, communication (baat-cheet) aur zimmedari maqsad zyada behtar tareeqe se hasil karne mein kaise madad karte hain (Figure 9.3 dekhein).

Computing mein equity (insaf aur barabari) yaqeeni banati hai ke har koi, chahe us ka pas-e-manzar ya salahiyat kuch bhi ho, barabar shirkat kar sake aur digital wasail (resources) tak pohanch sake. Collaboration ko insaf ke saath milana sab ko shamil karne wala (inclusive) aur mo-assar parhai aur kaam ka mahol banata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar muskurate talaba laptops ke saath aik mez par baithe hain; laptops ki pusht dekhne wale ki taraf hai. Upar aik cloud teen lakeeron se group se jura hai. Tasveer par koi label nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Digital ishtirak (collaboration) (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cloud aik mushtarka jagah hai jahan files online rakhi jati hain. Teen lakeerein dikhati hain ke chaaron talaba alag laptops se usi aik cloud se jure hain, is liye sab aik hi dastavez par aik saath kaam kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Digital collaboration aur equity in computing ka matlab apne alfaaz mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: Digital collaboration: technology se mil kar shared tasks, projects ya ideas par kaam, alag jagahon se internet ke zariye. Equity: har shakhs, chahe pas-e-manzar ya salahiyat kuch bhi ho, digital wasail tak barabar rasai aur hissa le sake.

items: Digital collaboration: internet se mil kar kaam; teamwork, communication aur zimmedari.
Equity: sab ke liye barabar rasai; dono mil kar inclusive mahol banate hain.
